name: Release 2.0.0
body:
## 新功能
- 升级基础架构到最新稳定的electron+vue3
- 重构配置session功能，简化本地配置文件的存储方式
- 新增本地AI集成，用于session里面的快速问题定位以及交互
- 新增侧边框状态栏图标展示功能
- ssh2文件下载速度优化提升
- 新增远程配置文件的端点配置，目前支持sftp协议远程读取配置

## What's Changed
* refactor to typescript by @nxshell2 in https://github.com/nxshell2/nxshell20/pull/6
* fix config ssh cert by @nxshell2 in https://github.com/nxshell2/nxshell20/pull/7
* add macos intel and linux arm64 build target by @nxshell2 in https://github.com/nxshell2/nxshell20/pull/8


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/nxshell2/nxshell20/compare/release/v2.0.0-beta...release/v2.0.0

name: Release 2.0.0-beta
body:
## What's Changed

### New Features
- **AI 助手**：内置 AI 助理功能
- **系统监控**：新增系统监控面板
- **SFTP 远程文件系统挂载**：支持远程会话配置挂载，挂载点支持 loading / offline / error 等状态显示
- **串口支持优化**：修复串口设备路径与新版 `serialport` 库的兼容性

### Improvements
- **xterm.js 升级**：升级至 xterm.js v6.0，提升终端渲染与稳定性
- **UI 图标与状态**：挂载点图标视觉区分远程与本地方案
- **构建脚本**：优化构建流程，修复打包警告

### Bug Fixes
- 修复 [util.isDate]被废弃导致的 `nxshell-ssh2` 运行时错误
- 修复串口 `SerialPort` 构造函数调用方式
- 修复屏幕锁定失效问题
- 修复挂载点刷新超时未捕获导致的全局报错
- 修复远程挂载点加载失败后 UI 状态未切换为 offline 的问题
- 修复构建过程中的 lint 与未使用变量警告

### Notes
- 本次为 v2.0.0-beta 版本

## What's Changed
* fix screen lock invalid by @nxshell2 in https://github.com/nxshell2/nxshell20/pull/1
* Feat/ai provider by @nxshell2 in https://github.com/nxshell2/nxshell20/pull/2
* Feat/xtermjs upgrade by @nxshell2 in https://github.com/nxshell2/nxshell20/pull/3
* support load remote config by @nxshell2 in https://github.com/nxshell2/nxshell20/pull/4
* fix build error by @nxshell2 in https://github.com/nxshell2/nxshell20/pull/5

## New Contributors
* @nxshell2 made their first contribution in https://github.com/nxshell2/nxshell20/pull/1

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/nxshell2/nxshell20/commits/release/v2.0.0-beta
